caseNameFull: Demos v. Washington Demos v. United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit

opinions.text:
C. A. 9th Cir.; and

C. A. 9th Cir. Motions of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. See this Court’s Rule 39.8. Petitioner is allowed until March 29, 1993, within which to pay the docketing fees required by Rule 38(a) and to *971submit petitions in compliance with Rule 33 of the Rules of this Court.

Justice Blackmun and Justice Stevens would deny the petitions for writs of certiorari.
